notes: Added kb_enabled guard to handle_kb_view_dm and handle_kb_view_group, mirroring the existing guard in handle_remember (renamed _REMEMBER_KB_DISABLED -> shared _KB_DISABLED). Early message.answer() with explicit disabled-KB text before any facts are fetched -- no silent return, per the aiogram update-consumption gotcha in CLAUDE.md. Added 2 regression tests asserting the disabled response text, that facts never leak into it, and that get_active_facts is not even called. Out of scope, flagging for PM: handle_kb_view_page (the kb_view: pagination callback) does not receive chat_config at all and has no kb_enabled check -- if KB is disabled after a paginated /kb view was already sent, the old inline-keyboard buttons can still page through facts. Plan's S2-8 description only names the two view handlers, so left this as-is; worth a follow-up item if the gap matters.
